items.title: Dick Hyman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I’ve known guys who reminded me strongly of that Emmett Ray, and I’d better not name them.

ctx.x: Yeah. Did you like the script?

I thought it was very funny and strangely true to life. I’ve known several people like this. I’ve known guys who reminded me strongly of that Emmett Ray, and I’d better not name them. © Fillius Jazz Archive -2-
Yeah. He kind of had all his eggs in one basket you know, so musical but a little short on the social skills and all that.
